name: Exterior Deck Surface Preparation
intent: Moisture test, seasoning verify, mill glaze sand, floor sand, wash, mildew treat, railing/spindle sand.
doctrine: Deck prep. MC < 15% hard stop. Seasoning verify for new wood (30+ days). Mill glaze sand 50 SF/hr on new pressure-treated. Floor/railing/spindle sanding. No spray on deck — stain is brush/roll/pad. Mildew treatment conditional.
